title: Homelab · CPU / GPU Capacity
description: Managed in Ansible. Host names are inventory identities, independent of IP or Swarm placement. Empty panels mean the exporter has not reported that metric; they do not imply a healthy zero.

panels.title: Physical capacity, guest demand, individual engines

options.content: Physical overall CPU is weighted by reported logical CPUs; VM/LXC demand is separate to avoid double counting hardware. GPU values are engine busy time, not FLOPs. LXC reported CPU IDs can reflect the parent topology and are not independent allocated capacity.

panels.title: Physical CPU utilization
panels.description: Weighted by physical-host logical CPUs; SMT threads are not physical cores.

targets.expr: 100 * sum((1 - max by(host,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on(host) group_left() max by(host)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",kind="physical"})) / count(max by(host,cpu)(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"}) * on(host) group_left() max by(host)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",kind="physical"}))

panels.title: Physical GPU inventory
panels.description: Unique physical devices, including unsupported inventory-only Apple GPU. Inventory count is not a count of measured utilization streams.

panels.title: Selected host CPU
panels.description: Mapped Proxmox guests use authoritative PVE guest CPU usage; physical/unmapped hosts use native OS counters.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_cpu_usage_ratio{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host=~"$host",guest_id!=""})) or on(host) (100 * (1 - avg by(host) (max by(host,cpu)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle",host=~"$host"}[$__rate_interval])))))

panels.title: Selected host RAM
panels.description: Mapped Proxmox guests use configured guest memory accounting; physical/unmapped hosts use native OS available memory. Hypervisor ARC remains included.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_memory_usage_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) / max by(guest_id)(label_replace(pve_memory_size_bytes{job="pve",id=~"(qemu|lxc)/.+"},"guest_id","$1","id","(.*)")) * on(guest_id) group_right() max by(host,guest_id,kind)(node_monitoring_host_info{job="node",host=~"$host",guest_id!=""})) or on(host) (100 * (1 - max by(host)(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node",host=~"$host"}) / max by(host)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node",host=~"$host"})))

panels.title: Selected host · logical CPU / SMT threads · hottest first
panels.description: Sorted by actual utilization descending; CPU labels are reported logical IDs.

panels.title: Proxmox VM / LXC CPU demand
panels.description: Authoritative PVE guest CPU ratio, separated from physical host utilization.

panels.title: Selected physical temperature sensors
panels.description: Explicit physical temperature capability; inherited LXC sensors excluded.

options.content: Native desktop GPU utilization/temperature/memory/power appear only when vendor tooling reports them. Intel passthrough exposes engine duty cycles and clocks; GPU temperature is unreported. Apple inventory-only GPU remains visible in inventory with no fabricated busy, temperature or memory. Means are observed duty cycles, not throughput/FLOPs.

panels.title: Mean observed Render / 3D duty cycle
panels.description: Arithmetic mean of the same monitored render engine class. A busy-time indicator, not total GPU throughput or FLOP utilization.

panels.title: iGPU RC6 residency
panels.description: Reported low-power residency, not engine busy utilization.

panels.title: Physical sensor hotspot / host
panels.description: Hottest reported physical hwmon sensor per host; may be CPU, board or storage. Select a host above for individual sensor labels. Not a GPU temperature estimate.

panels.title: All physical GPU inventory · actual telemetry support
Native desktop GPU busy
panels.description: Driver-reported busy ratio; no invented Apple or Intel whole-device busy percentage.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(host,device)(gpu_utilization_ratio{job="node"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

panels.title: Native desktop GPU temperature
panels.description: Only actual vendor temperature readings; absence stays unavailable.

targets.expr: (max by(host,device)(gpu_temperature_celsius{job="node"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

panels.title: Native desktop GPU memory used
panels.description: Driver-reported visible GPU memory allocation, not total host RAM or a universal shared-memory limit.

targets.expr: (100 * max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_used_bytes{job="node"}) / (max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job="node"}) > 0) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

panels.title: Native desktop GPU power
panels.description: Actual GPU power only; missing counters are unsupported, not idle zero.

targets.expr: (max by(host,device)(gpu_power_watts{job="node"}) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)")) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)

panels.title: Mean native desktop GPU busy
panels.description: Arithmetic mean of vendor-reported busy-time ratios, not physical capacity or mixed CPU/GPU/FLOP throughput. Intel engine-class mean is shown separately. Only successful fresh adapters (<180s) are included.

targets.expr: 100 * avg((max by(host,device)(gpu_utilization_ratio{job="node"}) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)) * on(host,device) group_left(physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name) label_replace(max by(host,physical_host,physical_device,vendor,model_name,telemetry)(node_monitoring_gpu_inventory_info{job="node"}),"device","$1","physical_device","(.*)"))

panels.title: Desktop GPU adapter result
panels.description: Explicit native adapter status; unsupported Apple has no adapter and no invented status.

panels.title: Reported desktop GPU memory capacity
panels.description: Vendor-reported visible GPU memory only; does not aggregate unlike dedicated and shared memory pools.

targets.expr: max by(host,device)(gpu_memory_total_bytes{job="node"}) and on(host,device) (max by(host,device)(gpu_scrape_success{job="node"}) == 1) and on(host,device) ((time() - max by(host,device)(gpu_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="node"})) < 180)
